name: Meclonazepam
metabolism: A study investigating meclonazepam metabolism in both in the lab and in the body trials identified two major metabolites suitable as biomarkers: amino-meclonazepam and acetamido-meclonazepam.
summary: Meclonazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative structurally similar to clonazepam. It was never used as a medicine and has appeared online as a designer drug.
